method: Method: each listing page was fetched for its coordinates and amenity list, then Airbnb’s dated search was run over a small map box around it; a listing in the results is bookable at the quoted total, and one absent from a box whose results were exhausted is not offered for those dates. A box that still hit the page limit is marked “not determined”.

zermatt_fresh.banner: The summary below is from September. A fresh search finds that a January month with a washer inside the flat no longer fits 10k even on lodging alone. February and March fit on lodging alone through one studio for two; with two month passes, only Täsch in March fits, at about $9,040.

booking.intro: Read in a browser on 9 Nov 2026 for the same dates and two adults. Booking.com prices exclude Japan's 10% consumption tax and local accommodation or hot-spring taxes, as in September. Room types are not always the one priced in September, so the change is indicative.

notes.alps: Corrected 9 Nov 2026: six September quotes, for St Anton, Argentière and Sadama, were first published here as euros and converted to dollars. Airbnb had shown them in US dollars, so they appear here as shown, and their change is measured from that figure.
notes.rentals: Settled 9 Nov 2026: the Westgate studio for 9–16 Jan, which the scripted check could not determine, showed “Those dates are not available” when its listing page was read in the browser.
